A block of mass $m$ slides down a rough slope.
At position 1 the velocity of the block is $v_1$.
At position 2, which is a vertical distance $h$ below position 1, the velocity of the block is $v_2$.
Which expression gives the work done against friction by the block as it slides from position 1 to position 2?
(gravitational field strength = $g$; assume that air resistance is negligible)
